findings.detail: AC line 109 explicitly says 'Prefer a SINGLE nullable-settings projection (one row read into a nullable-tuple / anonymous shape) over three correlated subqueries — the three fields live in the same FleetSettings row.' The implementation reads AutoDispatchEnabled, AfterSeconds, and MaxRadiusKm via THREE separate correlated subqueries against FleetSettings for the same fleet, not a single joined row read. Results are correct and the cost is negligible on the small New-order set, and 'Prefer' is a soft directive; but this is the one place the code diverges from a stated AC. The developer handoff justifies it as 'mirrors OfferTimeoutJob's (int?) guard', which is thin — OfferTimeoutJob reads only ONE field so it set no three-subquery precedent.

Spec test_case 4 and the WI notes call for a pool-exhaustion assertion (all candidates excluded -> order stays New, proving no infinite re-offer). RunTick_TimedOutDriverExcluded_NextNearestAssigned asserts only that the next-nearest driver (driverB) is assigned; it does not add a second phase where driverB is also excluded/unavailable and asserts the order then stays New. The exhaustion path is covered only transitively by OutsideRadius and OfflineAndStaleDrivers (no-eligible -> stays New). The test is not mislabeled (its name does not claim exhaustion), so this is a coverage gap, not a false test.

verified.f1_within_tick_guard: PASS (top risk) - pending-Assigned exclusion built INSIDE each per-order fresh scope (AutoDispatchJob.cs:188-197), unioned with THIS order's Declined/Timeout payload driver ids (166-197), and passed as the single excludedDriverIds to NearestDriverSelector.SelectNearest (213-219). Uses the tenant-scoped db (NO IgnoreQueryFilters) so fleet isolation is free and a prior same-tick commit is visible when the next order re-queries. NOT computed in the scan phase. RunTick_TwoNewOrdersOneEligibleDriver_AssignsExactlyOne (517-554) genuinely proves exactly one of two competing orders is assigned to the shared driver and the other stays New: order A commits Assigned (driver still Free), then order B's fresh scope re-reads Assigned drivers and excludes it.
verified.state_machine_discipline: PASS - assign via OrderService.TransitionAsync(orderId, OrderTransition.Assign, Actor.System, new AssignPayload(DriverId, CurrentVehicleId), ct) (231-236); job never sets order.Status and never publishes OrderChanged. StaleVersion/IllegalTransition returned as IsSuccess==false are logged at Debug with Reason=FailureKind, no exception surfaced (244-252). RunTick_ManualAssignWinsRace_JobNoOp covers the scan-level Status==New filter (already-Assigned order never picked); RunTick_TwoConcurrentTicks_ExactlyOneAssignedEvent covers the TransitionAsync StaleVersion else-branch (exactly one Assigned event under Task.WhenAll).
verified.job_pattern_fidelity: PASS - internal sealed AutoDispatchJob : BackgroundService; ctor (IServiceScopeFactory, TimeProvider, ILogger) matches OfferTimeoutJob; thin PeriodicTimer(5s, timeProvider) ExecuteAsync -> RunTickAsync with the same OperationCanceledException-excluded catch + LogError; scan in one scope IgnoreQueryFilters+AsNoTracking; per-order FRESH scope resolves concrete CurrentTenant, sets FleetId, resolves TaxiDbContext + OrderService; one scope per order; (bool?)/(int?)/(int?) FleetSettings projection guard so a missing row -> null -> SKIP (opt-in asymmetry vs OfferTimeoutJob's 45s default) is correct.
verified.f2_projection_and_timing: PASS - CreatedAt and ScheduledAt added to scan projection (81-104); age check (CreatedAt.AddSeconds(AfterSeconds) <= now) and future-scheduled guard (ScheduledAt == null || ScheduledAt <= now) done IN MEMORY (111-118), no EF DateTimeOffset arithmetic. RunTick_FutureScheduledAt_OrderUntouched and RunTick_NotYetElapsed_OrderUntouched pin both.
verified.exclusion_completeness: PASS - Declined+Timeout OrderEvents loaded via ToListAsync FIRST (160-164), payloads parsed IN MEMORY (167-184) per the jsonb LINQ-projection trap; declinedDriverId/timedOutDriverId collected into HashSet. Complete because only Assigned->New paths (Decline, Timeout) write a driver id. RunTick_TimedOutDriverExcluded_NextNearestAssigned proves a timed-out driver is not re-offered (exhaustion assertion only transitive - see finding 2).
verified.eligibility: PASS - DriverCandidate projected from tenant-scoped IsActive Drivers (200-210); Free-only/fresh/in-radius/non-excluded predicate lives in the WI-1 pure selector; RunTick_OfflineAndStaleDrivers_OrderStaysNew and RunTick_DriverOutsideRadius_OrderStaysNew confirm exclusions.
verified.tenant_isolation: PASS - per-order scope sets CurrentTenant.FleetId = order.FleetId; driver/order_events/Assigned-driver reads run under the query filter (no IgnoreQueryFilters). RunTick_TenantIsolation_FleetBOrderUnaffected asserts fleet A assigned to its own driver, fleet B untouched.
verified.logging: PASS - LogInformation on assign (OrderId/DriverId/FleetId, event-style, no PII); LogDebug NoEligibleDriver with stable Reason; LogDebug benign skip with FailureKind Reason; LogWarning per-order exception; LogError unhandled tick. No per-tick spam.
verified.test_coverage: PASS - all 8 spec test cases present plus future-scheduled, within-tick double-assign, and concurrent-tick (13 total). Every test asserts real DB effects (Status/DriverId/Assigned-event count). Seeded-OrderEvent FK trap (FleetId/FromStatus/ToStatus/ActorRole non-nullable) handled in TimedOutDriverExcluded and ManualAssignWinsRace; documented in CLAUDE.md note (accurate).
verified.scope_style_naming: PASS - only WI-2's 3 code files (AutoDispatchJob.cs, JobsServiceExtensions.cs, AutoDispatchJobTests.cs) plus the CLAUDE.md note staged for this WI. internal sealed, primary ctor for DI, TimeProvider (no DateTime.UtcNow), guard clauses, async/ct forwarded, XML docs on public/internal members, file-scoped namespace, Method_State_Expected test names.
